dialogues.speaker: Dornman Port Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: "Welcome to Dornman Port. To better serve both residents and travelers, the Knights of Favonius have installed this public notice board. Messages and announcements of all kinds may be posted here."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Exit

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "May the Anemo Archon watch over my father at sea and guide him safely home..."

dialogues.speaker: Message From the Knights of Favonius
dialogues.text: "First of all, may the Anemo Archon hear your prayer. That said, this board is meant for public notices, not for making wishes. Please direct such prayers to the Church of Favonius there instead. The devout brothers and sisters there will gladly pray with you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Come to think of it, I always assumed that little building by the harbor was one of your Church of Favonius branches, the legendary oldest cathedral in Mondstadt, said to rival even our Pale Crown Palace in Snezhnaya in sheer grandeur..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Then the other day I went there hoping to make a confession, only to discover that the church's 'premises' are actually just the open space in front. The building itself is the Fishing Association headquarters, and it's full of fishermen."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "What am I supposed to conclude from that? Does fishing outrank the church here?"

dialogues.speaker: Message From the Knights of Favonius
dialogues.text: "Please do not misunderstand the situation. The current arrangement is due to the chapel's rather convoluted history. At present, the Church of Favonius' premises in Dornman Port consist only of the open space before the Fishing Association headquarters. For further explanation, please consult the Church's priests and sisters."

dialogues.speaker: Notice from the Dornmannshaven Trade House
dialogues.text: "To mark the triumphant return of our knights, the Dornmannshaven Trade House has reached an agreement with the trade guilds of Dornman Port. For the next three months starting today, the price of all alcoholic beverages throughout the port will be reduced by one third."

dialogues.speaker: Notice from the Dornmannshaven Trade House
dialogues.text: "Raise your cups, friends! To freedom, to the homeward winds! Let us drink deeply and celebrate their glorious victory!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Looking for a missing young female. Has blonde hair, wears exotic clothes. Any information/assistance greatly welcomed."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Please report to Outrider Amber with any information you may have. Many thanks!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Looking for a missing young male. Has blond hair, wears exotic clothes. Any information/assistance greatly welcomed."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Please report to Outrider Amber with any information you may have. Many thanks!"

dialogues.speaker: Knights of Favonius Notice
dialogues.text: "In recent days, several thefts have occurred in the market district. Residents and travelers are advised to remain vigilant."

dialogues.speaker: Knights of Favonius Notice
dialogues.text: "Should you notice anyone behaving suspiciously, please report the matter to the Knights of Favonius immediately."

dialogues.speaker: A Slightly Faded Message
dialogues.text: "Generous reward offered for a private swordsmanship tutor. Applicants must be skilled in practical combat and capable of training my daughter, who currently has no experience at all, to defeat a Ruin Grader on her own within half a month. Interested parties may leave a message."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "...Who put this notice up? Half a month? Who do you think your daughter is — Varka, Arundolyn, or Guhua?"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Still talking about martial arts? In this day and age, it's weapons that matter!"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Guns! From seventy paces away you can shoot a Ruin Grader straight through its sensor!"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "If you're willing to pay, I'll make sure your daughter gets the best equipment available. Just leave your address here. Once the payment comes through, I'll send it right over."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Hah! Listen to this guy, bragging about muskets. If you're that confident, come trade a few blows with me. Forget Ruin Graders! You probably couldn't even beat me."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "If you think you deserve that reward, then so do I. Pick me instead. I worked as a mercenary in Port Belovodye for years, and I've got no patience for loudmouth cowards."

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "(Scratched-out words.) A few rounds, huh? Sure, let's do it. You Snezhnayans really think I'm scared of you? Midnight tonight, east side of the port. I'll be waiting there for you, you (scratched-out words). Don't chicken out!"

dialogues.speaker: More Recent Notice from the Knights of Favonius
dialogues.text: "The suspect responsible for illegally smuggling muskets through Lumidouce Harbor has been apprehended. The Knights extend their thanks to General Manager Cassigneul for proposing the strategy that led to the arrest."

dialogues.speaker: Knights of Favonius Notice
dialogues.text: "At the diplomatic request of the Snezhnograd Veche, all ships arriving from Snezhnaya must now register the shipowner's identity, any cargo being transported, and the purpose of entry upon docking. This measure is intended to prevent further smuggling."

dialogues.speaker: Knights of Favonius Notice
dialogues.text: "The regulation will remain in effect for at least one year. In accordance with the principle of freedom of trade — also acknowledged by the Snezhnayan delegation during negotiations — Mondstadt will not impose penalties on those who fail to comply. Any resulting consequences, however, must be borne by the individuals concerned."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, are there any plans to rebuild the sanatorium on Windrest Peak?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I just got back from Natlan, and their resort villages were incredible."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It got me thinking, what if Mondstadt imported phlogiston from Natlan and built a massive phlogiston waterfall, like Fontaine's high seas? Then we could use Liyue's Plaustrite to lift the whole sanatorium into the sky! Maybe even invite dancers from Sumeru to perform..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If we did all that, wouldn't the tourists who were planning to visit Natlan end up flocking to Mondstadt instead?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "...You know, in a way, it sounds like you might be the one who needs a stay at the sanatorium."

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: "We trade in precious gems, rare ores, and all related products from Liyue! We have longstanding partnerships with numerous shipping fleets, guaranteeing sufficient supply and stable sales channels."

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Please note that, due to internal planning adjustments within the guild, the shipping route previously operating to Port Belovodye has been temporarily suspended."

dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Commerce Guild Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Merchants in possession of high-quality specialty goods (such as fae-crafted items, precious metal works, or legally traded antiques) are welcome to speak with our liaison in Dornman Port regarding potential trade. We appreciate your understanding."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, people of Dornman Port! I'm opening a tavern here soon, specializing in premium fruit wine imported straight from Sumeru! Make sure you come by and support the business!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Wait. You're planning to import fruit wine from Sumeru... and sell it here?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Exactly! That's how business works! I even paid a fortune-teller from Sumeru in Nasha Town for advice. She said my tavern is guaranteed to make a fortune!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh. And where are you planning to open it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Right next to Boss Frith's place, ideally. She sells wine, I sell wine — it's what the fortune-teller called a 'commercial cluster.' Once that's in place, the money just rolls in!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...Though the rent around there might be pretty steep. I might not get the place even with a loan. But if that doesn't work out, I'll just open up on Windrest Peak instead. Fewer customers maybe, but the profits should still be great!"
